row.name: Telekinetic Weapon Mastery
row.effect: Control 1 weapon telekinetically; it attacks using your Telekinesis skill in place of its normal skill.

levels.name: Telekinetic Weapon Mastery
levels.description: The Force-user forgoes physical grip entirely, animating and wielding one or more weapons purely through the Force. Attacks with a telekinetically-wielded weapon use the character's Telekinesis skill in place of the weapon's normal DX-based skill (e.g. Lightsaber Combat) for both to-hit and parry rolls. The user's own body has no physical grip on the weapon and gains no bonus to its own physical Parry; a Master-tier user can extend a telekinetic parry to their own body.
levels.effect: Control 1 weapon telekinetically; it attacks using your Telekinesis skill in place of its normal skill.
